dashboard.label: TA-zfspool Overview
dashboard.description: Collects storage-pool integrity from whatever is present: ZFS (zpool status/get), Linux md RAID (/proc/mdstat + mdadm --detail) and btrfs (filesystem usage + device stats). Emits

search.query: | mstats avg("zfspool.pools_total") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"degraded\":\s*(?<d>[01])" | mvexpand d | where d="1" | stats count(d) as value
| mstats avg("zfspool.subsystems") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"level\"") | spath input=o path=level | spath input=o path=state | spath input=o path=active_disks | spath input=o path=required_disks | spath input=o path=degraded | spath input=o path=recovery_pct | spath input=o path=failed_devices | spath input=o path=spare_devices | table host k level state active_disks required_disks degraded recovery_pct failed_devices spare_devices

index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"state_ok\"") | spath input=o path=state | spath input=o path=state_ok | spath input=o path=failed_vdevs | spath input=o path=scrub_pct | table host k state state_ok failed_vdevs scrub_pct

index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"uncorrectable\"") | spath input=o path=uncorrectable | spath input=o path=corrupted | table host k uncorrectable corrupted
